content: Aɛřam ɣar Ṣidqiya

Awař i dd-iffɣen zi SIDI ɣar Irmiya - umi Nabuxadraṣṣar, ajeǧid n Babil, d marra řɛeskar nnes d marra tigeldiwin n ddunect i iǧan sadu fus nnes d marra řegnus tuɣa ttmenɣan ak-d Urcalim u ak-d marra tineddam nnes - i innan:
“Ammu i iqqar SIDI, AREBBI n Israil: ‘Uyur uca siweř ak-d Ṣidqiya, ajeǧid n Yahuda, ini as: Ammu i iqqar SIDI, xzar, Necc ad wceɣ tandint-a deg ufus n ujeǧid n Babil u netta ad as iqqed timessi.

Uřa d cek s yixef nnec war tnejjmed i ufus nnes, maca ad cek ṭṭfen u ad cek wcen deg ufus nnes. Tiṭṭ di tiṭṭ ad tẓared ajeǧid n Babil uca ad kides tessiwřed zeg uqemmum ɣar uqemmum uca ad dd-tawḍed ař Babil.
Seř maca i wawař n SIDI, Ṣidqiya, ajeǧid n Yahuda. Ammu i xak iqqar SIDI: ‘Cek war tᵉttwanɣed ca s ssif.

Ad temmted di řehna uca am mammec ssarɣen timessiyat i řejdud nnec, ijeǧiden n zic nni tuɣa iǧan qbeř i cek, ad ssarɣen ɛawed d timessiyat i cek uca ad xak wten agejdur, ad inin: Ax, sidi!’, maɣar Necc ssiwřeɣ awař-a, ammu i iqqar SIDI.’”
Issiweř unabi Irmiya marra awařen-a i Ṣidqiya, ajeǧid n Yahuda, di Urcalim,

umi tuɣa řɛeskar n ujeǧid n Babil ittmenɣa ak-d Urcalim u ak-d marra tineddam n Yahuda nni iqqimen, ak-d Laxic d Ɛaziqa, maɣar tina tuɣa ɛad qqiment jar tneddam n Yahuda, minzi tuɣa atent d tineddam ifaryen.
Awař nni dd-iffɣen zi SIDI ɣar Irmiya, awarni ma iqqen ujeǧid Ṣidqiya ijj n řɛahd ak-d marra řgens nni iǧan di Urcalim, maḥend ad barrḥen s ijj n usarreḥ jar asen,
maḥend kuř ijjen ad yarxu i ismeɣ nnes u i tayya nnes, i Uɛibrani u i Tɛibranect, ařami war ittɣimi jar asen uřa d ijjen wenni iǧan d ismeɣ ɣar ijj n weryaz zi Yahuda, ɣar umas.

Marra řḥukkam d marra řgens nni iqqnen řɛahd, sřin aqa kuř aryaz ad yarxu i ismeɣ nnes u kuř aryaz ad yarxu i tayya nnes ḥima war ittɣimi ɣarsen uřa d ijj n ismeɣ. Nitni wcin amezzuɣ i man aya uca ssekken ten.
Maca awarni as beddřen, arrin-dd isemɣan d tiyya inni umi tuɣa arxun, ḥṣaren ten ɛawed maḥend ad iřin ɛawed d imsemɣan d tiyya.
Xenni yusa-dd wawař n SIDI ɣar Irmiya, inna:
“Ammu i iqqar SIDI, AREBBI n Israil: ‘Necc ggiɣ ijj n Řɛahd ak-d řejdud nwem deg wass nni di ten dd-ssuffɣeɣ zi Miṣra, zi taddart n tesmuɣi, nniɣ:

Awarni řami ɛdun sebɛa n iseggʷusa ittxeṣṣa kuř ijj ad issekk umas Aɛibrani nni d ac izzenzen ixef nnes uca tuɣa ixeddem i cek setta n iseggʷusa. Ittxeṣṣa ad as tarxud ad yuyur di třelli! Maca řejdud nwem war ɣari dd-sřin u war d ayi wcin ca amezzuɣ.
Waxxa kenniw tdewřem-dd, teggim min iǧan nican di tiṭṭawin inu am ibarreḥ kuř ijj s usarxu i jjar nnes uca teggim ijj n řɛahd zzat i wudem inu di Taddart min xef ittwabarreḥ Isem inu,

kenniw maca tennqeřbem ɛawed uca tessɛiǧtem Isem inu. Kuř ijj yarra-dd ismeɣ nnes u kuř ijj yarra-dd tayya nnes nni umi tuɣa tarxum maḥend ad uyuren nitni mani xsen, uca kenniw teḥṣarem ten ɛawed maḥend ad awem iřin d imsemɣan d tiyya.’”

“S uya, ammu i iqqar SIDI: ‘Kenniw war ɣari tesřim maḥend kuř ijj ad ibarreḥ s usarxu i umas u kuř ijj i jjar nnes. Xzar, ammu Necc ad awem barrḥeɣ s usarxu, ammu i iqqar SIDI, maḥend ad kenniw sellmeɣ i ssif, i ṭṭaɛun u i řaẓ. Necc ad kenniw ggeɣ d ict n řqecɛet n unexřiɛ i marra tigeldiwin n ddunect.
Necc ad arreɣ iryazen nni iɛdun x řɛahd inu, inni war iṭṭifen deg wawařen n řɛahd nni ggin zzat i wudem inu, am uɛejmi nni bḍan x tnayen d wenni jar izeynat nnes cuqen nitni:
řḥukkam n Yahuda d řḥukkam n Urcalim, imsexxaren icennɛen, ikehhanen d marra řgens n temmurt, inni icuqen marra jar iziynat n uɛejmi.
Necc ad ten wceɣ deg ufus n řɛedyan nsen u deg ufus n yinni yarezzun ad ten nɣen uca řxecbat nsen ad iřint d macca i ijḍaḍ n ujenna u i řmař n temmurt.
Uřa d Ṣidqiya, ajeǧid n Yahuda, d řḥukkam nnes ad ten ggeɣ deg ufus n řɛedyan nsen, deg ufus n yinni yarezzun tudart nsen, deg ufus n řɛeskar n ujeǧid n Babil nni xawem iffɣen řexxu.

Xzar, Necc ad umureɣ, ammu i iqqar SIDI, u Necc ad ten dd-arreɣ ɣar tendint-a u nitni ad kides mmenɣen, ad tt ṭṭfen uca ad as qqden timessi. Necc ad arreɣ tineddam n Yahuda d ict n temmurt ittwareddǧen, war dayes ittɣimi uřa d ijj n umezduɣ ɛad.’”

footnotes.text: inni yarezzun ad ten nɣen- s Tɛibranit ‘inni yarezzun řeɛmar nsen’.
